manifest.name: Wyrd Group public proof register
manifest.note: The previous version of this file contained illustrative commit hashes, an illustrative signature and a Rust command against what is currently a Python repository. Those were placeholder values written to show the register's shape and should never have been presented as real evidence. They have been removed rather than published. This register goes live only once generated by CI directly from the pinned repositories below, with commands that match each repo's real toolchain, real timestamps, real results, and a detached ed25519 signature over the exact JSON payload, verifiable against a published public key.
manifest.verification_key: not yet published — will be posted at https://wyrd-group.com/.well-known/proof-signing-key.pub once the generator ships
manifest.combination_rule: A combined figure requires all six: duplicates removed, branches pinned, dates current, commands reproducible, skips disclosed, generated checks separated from behavioural tests. Until all six hold, only per-system receipts are published — and only once they are real.
